Izikhangiso zokuhlola
Vula “Sebenzisa izikhangiso zokuhlola” ukuze ubone izikhangiso zedemo ngokushesha. Ayikho i-akhawunti ye-AdMob edingekayo.

Izikhangiso zangempela
1. Dala uhlelo lokusebenza ku-AdMob bese ukopisha i-ID yohlelo lokusebenza.
2. Dala amayunithi ezikhangiso (Isibhengezo, I-Interstitial, Evuzwayo) bese ukopisha i-ID ngayinye.
3. Namathisela ngenhla.

Lawula kusuka ku-HTML yakho
• Isibhengezo: AndroidAPI.adsLoadBanner(id, bottom) bese adsShowBanner()
• I-Interstitial: AndroidAPI.adsLoadInterstitial(id) bese adsShowInterstitial()
• Evuzwayo: AndroidAPI.adsLoadRewarded(id) bese adsShowRewarded()

Amathiphu
• Isibhengezo: sigcina umugqa omncane wesikhangiso esikrinini.
• I-Interstitial: isikhangiso esigcwele isikrini. Sebenzisa ngokulinganiselayo.
• Evuzwayo: umsebenzisi ubuka ukuze athole umvuzo.
Isikhangiso se-interstitial sizoboniswa ngokuzenzakalelayo njalo ngemizuzwana engu-%1$d (%2$s).
Ukuboniswa okuzenzakalelayo kuvaliwe. Kuboniswa kuphela nge-AndroidAPI.showInterstitialAd() noma ukulayishwa kwekhasi.
Abasebenzisi babuka isikhangiso ukuze bathole imivuzo ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza (izinhlamvu zemali, izimpilo, njll.). Shayela i-AndroidAPI.showRewardedAd() kusuka ku-JavaScript yakho.
Vula lokhu ukuze ubonise izikhangiso kuhlelo lwakho lokusebenza.
Khetha ukuthi yiziphi izinhlobo zezikhangiso ongazisebenzisa nokuthi ziziphatha kanjani.

Nika amandla ukuhlola kwe-UMP (izikhangiso zokuhlola kuphela)

Inika amandla ukusetha kabusha kobumfihlo kanye nendawo yokuhlola kumadivayisi okuhlola we-UMP. Lezi zilungiselelo zikhutshaziwe ekwakhiweni okusebenzisa izikhangiso ezibukhoma. Ukusetha kabusha kuyatholakala nge-AndroidAPI.adsResetConsent().

Hlukanisa ama-hashi ngokusebenzisa okukhomba (commas) noma imigqa emisha. Sebenzisa i-hashi yedivayisi evela kulogi ye-UMP; ama-ID okuhlola we-Google Mobile Ads ahlukile. Ama-emulator ayizidivayisi zokuhlola ngokuzenzakalelayo.

Shicilela imiyalezo yobumfihlo yohlelo lwakho lokusebenza ku-AdMob Privacy & Messaging. Khetha izilungiselelo zeminyaka ezihambisana nezithameli zakho; okungacacisiwe kugcina okuzenzakalelayo kwe-SDK.

Ongakukhetha kumodi yezikhangiso zokuhlola: faka i-ID yakho yohlelo lokusebenza lwe-AdMob ukuze uhlole imiyalezo yakho ye-UMP eshicileliwe. Shiya kungenalutho ukuze usebenzise i-ID yohlelo lokusebenza lwesampula ye-Google. Wonke ama-ID weyunithi yesikhangiso ahlala eyi-ID yokuhlola.

Ithiphu: faka isithombe-skrini senani lokubukwa ku-imeyili yakho ukuze usheshise ukuqinisekiswa.
Rekhoda ividiyo ekhombisa uhlelo lokusebenza noma umdlalo owenzile nge-HTML2APK bese wabelana ngayo ku-YouTube, TikTok noma Instagram.
Uma ividiyo yakho isifinyelele ekubukweni okungu-10,000 kunoma yimaphi lawa mapulatifomu, umvuzo wakho usulungile.
Sithumelele isixhumanisi sevidiyo yakho nge-imeyili. Sizoyiqinisekisa bese sikuthumela ikhodi yokuvula i-Pro ongayisebenzisa ku-Google Play.

Uma uvule i-Play App Signing, hamba ku-Play Console App Signing bese ucela ukusethwa kabusha kokhiye wokulayisha. Khipha isitifiketi se-PEM kusuka ku-keystore yakho kulolu hlelo lokusebenza bese ulandela imiyalelo yakwa-Google. Ngaphandle kwe-Play App Signing, i-keystore elahlekile ayikwazi ukubuyiselwa futhi kufanele ushicilele uhlelo lokusebenza olusha.

Uma ulondoloze ikhophi eqhubekayo ye-keystore yakho, vula i-Keystore Manager bese uthepha okuthi Thola izipele kudivayisi ukuze uyibuyisele. Ungaphinda ungenise kabusha ifayela le-P12 kusuka kusipele sakho samafu noma sekhompyutha.
Vakashela iwebhusayithi ye-Google Play Console bese ukhokha imali yokubhalisa engu-$25 kanye kuphela. Uzodinga i-akhawunti yakwa-Google kanye nekhadi lesikweletu/ledebhithi.

Kulolu hlelo lokusebenza, dala iphrojekthi ngokuqukethwe kwakho kwe-HTML, setha igama lohlelo lokusebenza negama lephakheji, khetha isithonjana, lungiselela izinguqulo ze-SDK, bese uthepha okuthi Yakha i-APK. Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa i-keystore efanayo kuzo zonke izibuyekezo ezizayo.

Ku-Play Console, iya ku-Create app. Faka igama lohlelo lwakho lokusebenza, ulimi oluzenzakalelayo, isigaba sohlelo lokusebenza, nokuthi ingabe uhlelo lokusebenza lwamahhala noma olukhokhelwayo. Bhala incazelo emfushane kanye nencazelo ephelele (ubuningi bezinhlamvu ezingama-80 nezingama-4000).
Gcwalisa uhlu lwemibuzo lokulinganisa okuqukethwe ngokwethembeka. Lokhu kunquma isilinganiso seminyaka yohlelo lwakho lokusebenza futhi kuyadingeka ngaphambi kokushicilela.

Uma uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza luqoqa noma yiluphi ulwazi lomsebenzisi noma lusebenzisa i-inthanethi, i-Google idinga i-URL yenqubomgomo yobumfihlo. Ungakwazi ukuzenzela eyodwa elula mahhala ku-inthanethi.
Iya kokuthi Production > Releases > Create release. Layisha i-APK yakho esayiniwe. I-Google Play izoyiskena ukuze ithole izinkinga zokuphepha. Lungisa noma yiziphi izixwayiso ngaphambi kokwethula.

Bukeza zonke izigaba ukuze uthole amamaki aluhlaza. Uma konke sekuqediwe, chofoza okuthi Qala ukwethula ku-Production. Uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza luzobuyekezwa yi-Google futhi ngokuvamile luya bukhoma phakathi kwezinsuku ezi-1-3.
Ukuze ukhiphe isibuyekezo, khulisa ikhodi yakho yenguqulo, yakha kabusha i-APK nge-keystore efanayo, bese uyilayisha njengokukhishwa okusha ku-Play Console.
Ukuze ukhiphe isibuyekezo, khulisa ikhodi yakho yenguqulo, yakha kabusha i-APK nge-keystore efanayo, bese uyilayisha njengokukhishwa okusha ku-Play Console.
Awekho amafayela e-APK noma e-AAB ahlanganisiwe atholakele kule phrojekthi okwamanje.
I-cache yohlelo lokusebenza idlule ku-100 MB futhi isuswe ngokuzenzakalelayo.
Ingabe ufuna ukufaka i-keystore yokusayina iphrojekthi ekuthekeliseni? Lokhu kukuvumela ukuthi usebenzise kabusha ukhiye ofanayo ncamashi lapho ungenisa kamuva.
Kuhlulekile ukulondoloza ukuhleleka kwephrojekthi. Sicela uzame futhi.

Ukwakha okuthuthukile kunezinyathelo eziyishumi: ulwazi lohlelo lokusebenza (igama, igama lephakheji eliyingqayizivele, inguqulo), okuqukethwe, ukuboniswa (ukuma, ibha yesimo, isikrini esigcwele), izimvume, isithonjana, isikrini sokuqalisa, izilungiselelo ze-WebView noma isifundi se-PDF, izikhangiso, isifinyezo kanye nokukhiphayo. Maka kuphela izimvume uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza oluzisebenzisayo ngempela.

Khetha ifayela le-HTML noma ifolda yesayithi lakho noma i-ZIP (ikhasi lokuqala yi-index.html), i-URL yewebhusayithi, i-HTML oyinamathiselayo, noma i-PDF. Izinhlelo zokusebenza ze-URL zihlale zithola imvume ye-inthanethi. Amafayela endawo apakishwa ngaphakathi kohlelo lokusebenza futhi asebenza ungaxhunyiwe ku-inthanethi.

Kuthebhu yamaphrojekthi, thepha okuthi Dala Iphrojekthi bese ukhetha indawo yokuqala: Ukwakha okusheshayo kuphendula okuqukethwe kwakho kube uhlelo lokusebenza ekhasini elilodwa; Ukwakha okuthuthukile kukuhambisa kuzo zonke izilungiselelo; Vula i-PDF kuvula isifundi; Vula / hlela i-HTML kuvula umhleli wekhodi ngefayela noma ikhasi elingenalutho.
Khetha okuqukethwe kwakho bese ukhetha imodi yokwakha.
Vula ifayela noma uqale ngekhasi elingenalutho.
Hlola umsebenzi wakho, bese udala i-APK noma i-AAB.
Vula idokhumenti ngaphandle kokuyiguqula ibe uhlelo lokusebenza.

Dala Iphrojekthi bese uvula / hlela i-HTML ukuze uvule umhleli wekhodi. Sebenzisa imibala ye-syntax, ukuqedwa kwethegi kanye nokuthola nokushintsha. Izinguquko zakho zihlala zitholakala uma ushintsha phakathi komhleli nokubuka kuqala. Ukubuka kuqala okwomklamo nokuqukethwe; i-AndroidAPI iyatholakala kuhlelo lokusebenza olwakhiwe.
Konke ukwakha kuyasayinwa. Izibuyekezo kufanele zisayinwe ngesikhiye esifanayo, ngakho-ke yenza isipele ngaphambi kokukhishwa kwakho kokuqala futhi ugcine amaphasiwedi endaweni ephephile.
Vikela ukhiye owudingayo ngezibuyekezo zesikhathi esizayo.

Hlela amaphrojekthi amafolda, futhi usebenzise imenyu yephrojekthi ukuze uyiqambe kabusha, uyiphindaphinde noma uyihambise. Amadokhumenti e-HTML ne-PDF owavula kusuka ku-Create Project angashintshwa abe izinhlelo zokusebenza kamuva.
Sebenzisa amafolda nezenzo zephrojekthi ukuze ugcine yonke into icocekile.

I-APK ingeyokufaka ocingweni lwakho noma ukwabelana ngayo ngokuqondile. I-AAB iyifomethi edingwa yi-Google Play (Pro). Nge-Pro ungaphinde uthumele iphrojekthi njengephrojekthi ye-Android Studio (ZIP) kusuka kumenyu yephrojekthi. Izakhiwo zangaphambilini zingaphansi kwe-Build Outputs kumenyu efanayo, futhi imenyu eyinhloko ingathumela noma ingenise amaphrojekthi njengezipele ze-ZIP.
Nge-HTML2APK, ungaguqula iwebhusayithi yakho noma amafayela e-HTML abe uhlelo lokusebenza lwangempela lwe-Android. Akukho ukubhala ikhodi okudingekayo!

Dala Iphrojekthi bese uvula / buka i-PDF ukuze uvule isifundi. Sondeza, shintsha phakathi kokufunda okukhanyayo nokumnyama, engeza amabhukumaka futhi uqhubeke ekhasini lakho lokugcina. Sebenzisa Hlela uma ufuna ukuhlela kabusha amakhasi noma ukubhala amanothi kudokhumenti. Ungaguqula idokhumenti ibe uhlelo lokusebenza kamuva.

Uma i-Play Console ibuza “Izintandokazi zokusayina uhlelo lokusebenza”, khetha inketho yokuqala: Vumela i-Google iphathe futhi ivikele ukhiye wakho wokusayina wohlelo lokusebenza (kunconyiwe).

Lokhu kunika amandla i-Play App Signing. I-Google igcina ukhiye wangempela wokusayina; ulayisha kuphela ama-APK/AAB asayinwe ngokhiye wakho wokulayisha.

Uma kamuva ulahlekelwa yi-keystore (isibonelo ngokukhipha i-HTML2APK), ungacela ukusethwa kabusha kokhiye wokulayisha ku-Play Console futhi abasebenzisi bazobe besathola izibuyekezo.

Uma kufanele ulayishe ukhiye wakho wokusayina, vula i-keystore kulolu hlelo lokusebenza bese uthepha Khipha ku-Play Store (PEPK). Khetha indlela efanayo eboniswa yi-Play Console (ukhiye womphakathi we-hex noma ukhiye womphakathi we-RSA PEM) ukuze ukhiqize output.zip bese uyilayisha.

Khetha kuphela “Khipha futhi ulayishe ukhiye wakho” uma uqinisekile ngokuphelele ukuthi ungawugcina lowo khiye uphephile phakade. Ukuwulahlekelwa kusho ukuthi awukwazi ukubuyekeza uhlelo lokusebenza futhi.
Qonda okhiye bokulayisha, i-Play App Signing kanye ne-PEPK.

Ukubuka kuqala kusebenzisa ikhasi lakho ngendlela uhlelo lokusebenza oluqediwe luzosebenza ngayo, kuhlanganise nezingcingo ze-AndroidAPI. Isihleli se-HTML sifaka imibala kukhodi yakho, sivale amathegi kuwe futhi sinomsebenzi wokuthola nokushintsha; izinguquko zigcinwa ngenkathi ushintsha uye ekubukeni kuqala bese ubuyela emuva.
Umhlahlandlela we-Play Store udlula ku-akhawunti, ukufakwa ohlwini lwesitolo, ukuphepha kwedatha, ukuhlola kanye nokubuyekezwa.
Suka ku-AAB eqediwe uye ku-Play Console.

Ithebhu yamathempulethi inezinhlelo zokusebenza esezilungile, iziqalo ezinemithetho yomtapo yolwazi ethandwayo nezibonelo zezici zomdabu (ukudlidliza, izaziso, ikhamera, indawo, izinzwa nokunye) i-HTML yakho engayibiza nge-AndroidAPI. Khetha eyodwa futhi izoba iphrojekthi entsha.
Qala ngesibonelo esisebenzayo esikhundleni sekhasi elingenalutho.

Ukuze ufake ama-APK, vumela ukufakwa okuvela kulolu hlelo lokusebenza kuzilungiselelo.
Ifayela lokhiye, amaphasiwedi alo alondoloziwe nanoma iyiphi ikhophi elondolozwe kokuthi Okulandiwe iyasuswa. Izinhlelo zokusebenza esezisayinwe ngalo zingabuyekezwa kuphela ngesipele salokhu khiye.

Amaphrojekthi asebenzisa lesi sikhiye, futhi nanoma yikuphi ukukopisha okugcinwe kokuthi Okulandiwe nakho kuyasuswa. Lawo maphrojekthi azosayinwa ngesikhiye esizenzakalelayo ngemuva kwalokho, futhi izinhlelo zokusebenza esezivele zisayinwe ngaso zingabuyekezwa kuphela ngesipele salesi sikhiye.

Uma ukhiphe i-HTML2APK, okhiye bokusayina bohlelo lokusebenza abakhiqizwe ngokuzenzakalelayo kungenzeka balahleke. Ukwakha okusha kuzosayinwa ngokhiye ohlukile futhi i-Play Store ingase yenqabe isibuyekezo.

Isixazululo 1 - Setha kabusha ukhiye wokulayisha (kunconyiwe):
1. Khipha isitifiketi se-PEM se-keystore yakho entsha ohlwini olungezansi.
2. Ku-Play Console, iya ku-Ukusayina kohlelo lokusebenza > Cela ukusethwa kabusha kokhiye wokulayisha.

Uma i-Play Console ikuvumela ukuthi ulayishe ukhiye omusha wokusayina wohlelo lokusebenza, sebenzisa Khipha ku-Play Store (PEPK) ku-keystore. Khetha indlela efanayo eboniswe ku-Play Console (ukhiye we-hex noma i-RSA PEM), khiqiza i-output.zip, bese uyilayisha.

Abasebenzisi bazoqhubeka nokuthola izibuyekezo ngoba ukhiye wokusayina wohlelo lokusebenza uhlala ne-Google uma usetha kabusha ukhiye wokulayisha kuphela.

Uma i-Play App Signing ikhutshaziwe futhi ulahlekelwe ukhiye wokusayina, kufanele ushicilele uhlelo lokusebenza futhi ngegama lephakheji elisha.
Isitolo sokhiye esizenzakalelayo sikhiqizwa ngokuzenzakalelayo. Nge-Pro, ungangenisa isitolo sokhiye sangokwezifiso futhi ugcine isiginesha yakho ekhona.

I-keystore iwusayini yedijithali yohlelo lwakho lokusebenza. KUMELE usebenzise i-keystore EFANAYO kukho konke ukubuyekeza kohlelo lokusebenza olushicilelwe ku-Google Play. Uma ulahlekelwa yiyo, ngeke usakwazi ukubuyekeza uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza!
Ayikho uhlelo lokusebenza kule divayisi olungaphatha lesi senzo.

Xhuma uhlelo lwakho lokusebenza lwewebhu ngokuqondile ezicini zedivayisi njengekhamera, i-GPS geolocation, imakrofoni, ukudlidliza, nesikhethi sefayela.

Ukufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ngaphandle kwesitolo (sideloading) kungase kudingeke izinyathelo ezengeziwe ezweni lakini. Thepha ngaphambi kokuba ufake.

Kusukela ngomhlaka-30 Septhemba, i-Google izoqalisa izidingo ezintsha zokuqinisekisa onjiniyela zokufakwa kwe-APK okuqondile e-Brazil, Indonesia, Singapore, nase-Thailand. Ukufaka ama-APK angaqinisekisiwe kumadivayisi agunyaziwe kungase kubangele \'Inqubo Ethuthukisiwe\' enezinyathelo zokuphepha ezengeziwe, noma kudingeke ukufakwa nge-ADB. Ukuthepha ukuze ufake ama-APK akhiwe lapha kungase kudingeke lezi zinyathelo ezengeziwe kumadivayisi akulezi zifunda.
Chofoza lapha ukuze uthole imininingwane eyengeziwe
I-akhawunti yakho isetshenziselwa i-AI kuphela. Sicela uqinisekise okulandelayo ukuze uqhubeke.
Ngifunde futhi ngamukela i-%1$s kanye ne-%2$s.
Ngiqala ngokuvuma ukuthi izicelo zami ze-AI nokuqukethwe kwephrojekthi okuthunyelwa nazo kucutshungulwe abahlinzeki besevisi phesheya, okuhlanganisa ne-United States.
Ungasihoxisa lesi sivumelwano nganoma yisiphi isikhathi ngokususa i-akhawunti yakho. Zonke izici ngaphandle kwe-AI zisebenza ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti.
Kumele ifane negama lephakheji lalolu hlelo lokusebenza ku-Google Play Console. Yishiye ingenalutho ukuze ikhiqize eyodwa ngokuzenzakalelayo.
